rawBridgePoolLifetime.previousDefect: Long-lived DataVault TryLockBuffer pins were used to protect native-exported bridge pointers, but those pins can block arena relocation/growth while the audio bridge is active.
rawBridgePoolLifetime.failureMode: Invalid sourceChannels records SharedStateInvalid telemetry when an existing ring is live and returns without disposing that known-good bridge. Oversized capacity requests clamp to the fixed 65,536-frame SPSC bridge budget before raw allocation, and both managed and native descriptor validation reject capacities above 65,536 frames. If any raw bridge allocation fails, Initialize disposes the partially initialized bridge and descriptor registration stays fail-closed. C# bridge validation re-reads SharedState capacity/mask/guards/source-channel metadata before P/Invoke and returns SharedStateInvalid if it no longer matches the descriptor/native contract. SourceChannels is copied into the immutable descriptor at NativeAudioFrameRingBuffer.cs:437, and native callback reads ringBuffer.sourceChannels at Plugin_HectonSensoryKernel.cpp:454 instead of trusting mutable SharedState for frame stride. Register and clear now use AndGetStatus exports so managed code reads the mutation result directly; callback health status cannot overwrite a failed mutation before managed observes it. If native clear fails for any status except PluginUnavailable while H8Memory is initialized, TryDispose returns false, raw buffers are retained, reinitialize is blocked before any second allocation, and PlayerCriticalProceduralAudioRenderer keeps _sampleRingBuffer as the owner so a later clear/free retry is still possible. Renderer EnsureBuffers validates IsCreated/capacity/source-channel after Initialize and tears down partial vault-backed buffers if the ring contract is not exact. If H8Memory is already shut down, raw pointers are nulled instead of retained because their backing memory has already been reaped, and TryResolveRingViews refuses to create NativeArray views over those stale addresses. If managed shared-state cursors are corrupt, TryReadSharedFrameIndex rejects raw indices outside [0, capacityFrames) instead of masking them through capacityMask; producer/DSP bookkeeping records TelemetryStatusSharedStateInvalid and triggers the dump route. Hot telemetry writes go to a stable H8Memory raw 300-entry ring and do not acquire a DataVault writer fence or call Thread.MemoryBarrier. The writer marks a slot Sequence=0 before field writes, publishes final non-zero Sequence last with Volatile.Write, and dump/mirror readers validate sequence plus StateHash through TryReadTelemetryEntryStable before copying a DTO. Fault/shutdown paths best-effort mirror the raw ring into BufferID.AudioFrameRingTelemetry with TryAcquireWriteLock; if the mirror lock is unavailable, the raw binary dump still proceeds and the writer does not block. Native dump export now performs the bounded C file write directly and returns write success/failure; C# rearms _telemetryDumpQueued in a finally scope after every native write attempt.
